label: Rhode Island: enforcement and cure opportunity
note: Editorial summary of the cited current primary law, not a verbatim statutory extract. Cure/enforcement checkpoint: September 22, 2026. Independent content review and practitioner review are separate. This card addresses the comprehensive privacy law's cure opportunity and enforcement actor, not a complete remedies schedule.
body: Section 6-48.1-8 gives the Attorney General sole enforcement authority for this chapter and permits enforcement through its stated commercial-law and deceptive-trade-practice provisions.

The comprehensive privacy chapter does not state a mandatory pre-enforcement cure notice or cure period. This summary does not resolve distinct procedures under the other commercial-law provisions referenced by the section.
